label: AI Agent
description: An AI that can use tools (search, APIs, your code) on its own, step by step, until the task is done. It reads and writes the conversation (the `messages` field). Technical: LangChain create_agent.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The AI model that does the thinking. Plug in an “AI model” block.

inputs.name: tools
inputs.description: Optional. Things the agent may use, such as a web API or your own Python function. Plug in any number of tool blocks.

inputs.name: middleware
inputs.description: Optional. Add-ons that change how the agent behaves: limits, retries, safety checks. They run in the order you connect them.

outputs.name: next
outputs.description: Where to go when the agent has finished: connect the next step, or Finish.

system_prompt.title: Instructions for the agent
system_prompt.description: Tell the AI who it is and how to behave, in plain words, e.g. “You are a friendly support assistant. Answer briefly.”

approve_tools.title: Tools that need approval
approve_tools.description: Pause for a human before these tools run (approve / edit / reject).

response_format.title: Structured output (JSON Schema)
response_format.description: When set, the agent's final answer is validated against this schema and written to the `structured_response` channel.
